key.name: accounts
key.description: The GitHub and GitLab accounts to show, one JSON object per account: id, platform, base (the instance's address), login, method (device or pat) and clientId. No tokens: each account's sign-in is in the GNOME keyring under its id.

key.name: repositories
key.description: List of repositories in owner/name form. Applies to github.com accounts.

key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: Minutes between GitHub checks.

key.name: layout
key.description: "separate": one top-bar icon per list. "tabs": one icon whose menu has a tab per list.

key.name: toolbar-buttons
key.description: Which lists to show: issues, prs, projects. The sourceglance button is always shown.

key.name: collapsed-sections
key.description: Account sections collapsed in the lists, as list:section (e.g. issues:gitlab). The first GitHub and GitLab sign-ins use github and gitlab; other accounts use their id.

key.name: collapsed-groups
key.description: Repositories and project boards collapsed in the lists, as list:platform:name (e.g. issues:github:owner/repo, or projects:github: and the board's node id).

key.name: widgets
key.description: Cards to show on the desktop: summary, issues, prs, projects.

key.name: widget-positions
key.description: Where each card was dragged to, in screen coordinates. Empty: default places.

key.name: widget-opacity
key.description: How opaque the cards are, in percent.

key.name: start-automatically
key.description: Show sourceglance in the top bar when you log in. When off, it stays hidden until you start it from Settings.

key.name: app-launcher
key.description: Add a sourceglance icon to the app grid and dock that starts sourceglance and opens its Settings.

key.name: start-request
key.description: Internal. Bumped by Settings' "Start now" to show sourceglance again after Quit.

key.name: quit-request
key.description: Internal. Bumped by Quit, in the top bar or the window, so the top bar, the desktop widgets and the window all stop.

key.name: refresh-request
key.description: Internal. Bumped by the sourceglance window after a change, so the top bar refreshes right away.

key.name: check-updates
key.description: When you log in and when the sourceglance window opens, ask GitHub whether a newer release is out. At login a notification says so; in the window, "Update available" shows in its title bar.

key.name: tasks-expanded
key.description: Whether the window's sidebar shows Issues, Pull requests and Projects under Tasks.

key.name: saved-wallpaper
key.description: Internal. The org.gnome.desktop.background values the recommended wallpaper replaced, kept by Glance → Desktop Widgets → Apply so Reset can put them back. Cleared when the wallpaper changes any other way.

key.name: install-update
key.description: Internal. Set by the update notification's Install button so the window starts the update, as if "Update available" were clicked.

key.name: open-page
key.description: Internal. Set by the top-bar menu (for example to "about") so the window shows that page.

key.name: token-changed
key.description: Internal. Bumped by Settings when an account is added or removed, so the extension refreshes right away.

key.name: sidebar-narrow
key.description: Whether the window's sidebar shows icons with short names under them (and counts on them) instead of icons, names and counts. On by default. Switched with the sidebar's menu button.
